answer: The defence rests on allotment society membership with plot cultivation history: a plot cultivated under one society for years. Forging 464 of these means building 464 separate cultivation histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The sparrow check runs in the open: 464 fakes pay the full price 464 times, one honest agent pays once, and the jade trail in the ledger makes the ivory cost visible to everyone.
